description.zh: 拦截生效时间（单位为秒，当类型为封禁时指定）。
description.en: The effective period of the block, in seconds. This parameter is required when the type is set to block.

description.zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~2850189~~)接口获取。
description.en: The site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation.

The type. Valid values:

- **block**: blocks the URLs.
- **unblock**: unblocks the URLs.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa block-object --site-id 1234560000 --type block --content http://a.com/1.jpg --maxage 864000 --region cn-hangzhou
